answer: The garden register is checked at draw time, kernel lists the eligible set, and ocean seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 82 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 82 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 203 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
